readme_excerpt: Chromium Chromium is an open-source browser project that aims to build a safer, faster, and more stable way for all users to experience the web. The project's web site is https://www.chromium.org. To check out the source code locally, don't use git clone! Instead, follow the instructions on how to get the code.
